title: Blood Donation Eligibility Quiz
source: Questionnaire CTS HUG : Transfusion CRS Suisse : ANH-Art7.6v3 - 1er fév. 2026
types_note: Types utilisés : yes_no | checklist (items[], options[aucun]) | travel_check (risk_map) | birth_check (items[], risk_map). QuizController@store doit être mis à jour pour gérer checklist/travel_check/birth_check.

questions.content: Are you between 18 and 75 years old?
questions.hint: Blood donation is open to adults between 18 and 75 years old in Switzerland.

options.label: No
options.disqualification_reason: Blood donation is reserved for people aged 18 to 75. You do not meet the required age criteria.

questions.content: Do you weigh more than 50 kg?
questions.hint: A minimum weight of 50 kg is required to ensure your safety during donation.

options.label: No
options.disqualification_reason: A minimum weight of 50 kg is required for safety reasons during blood collection.

questions.content: Do you feel in good health today?
questions.hint: No unusual fatigue, fever or discomfort today.

options.label: No
options.disqualification_reason: You must be in perfect health on the day of donation. Come back when you feel better.

questions.content: Have you donated blood before?
questions.hint: This helps us check the interval since your last donation.

options.label: No, this is my first time

questions.content: Was your last blood donation more than 8 weeks ago (men) or more than 12 weeks ago (women)?
questions.hint: This interval allows your body to replenish its reserves between two donations.

options.label: Yes, the interval has been respected
No, my last donation was more recent
options.disqualification_reason: The minimum interval between two donations must be respected: 8 weeks for men, 12 weeks for women. Come back when this interval has elapsed.

questions.content: In the last 14 days, have you had a dental treatment or procedure?
questions.hint: Examples: scaling, extraction, filling, root canal treatment, crown placement, gum care, professional whitening.

options.label: Yes
options.disqualification_reason: A dental treatment in the last 14 days requires a waiting period before donation, due to the risk of transient bacteraemia (passage of oral bacteria into the bloodstream).

questions.content: In the last 4 weeks, does any of these symptoms or treatments apply to you?
questions.hint: Select all that apply. If in doubt, report it to the medical staff.

items.label: Fever above 38°C
items.disqualification_reason: A recent fever (in the last 4 weeks) requires a waiting period of 4 weeks after temperature returns to normal before donating.

items.label: Cold, flu or respiratory tract infection
items.disqualification_reason: A recent respiratory infection requires a waiting period of 4 weeks after full recovery before donating.

items.label: Diarrhoea or gastroenteritis
items.disqualification_reason: A recent gastroenteritis requires a waiting period of 4 weeks after recovery before donating.

items.label: Medical consultation or medical care
items.disqualification_reason: Recent medical care may require a waiting period depending on its nature. The medical staff will assess your situation.

items.label: Use of antibiotics
items.disqualification_reason: A recent course of antibiotics requires a waiting period of 4 weeks after the end of treatment before donating blood.

questions.content: In the last 4 weeks, have you taken any medication, even without a prescription?
questions.hint: Tablets, injections, suppositories, patches, nasal sprays... If yes, the medical staff will assess compatibility with donation.

questions.content: Have you taken any of the following medications within the indicated timeframes?
questions.hint: These treatments result in a temporary or permanent contraindication to donation, regardless of your current health status.

items.label: Prostate or hair loss treatment
items.sublabel: Proscar®, Propecia®, Finasterid®, Avodart®, Duodart® : last 6 months
items.disqualification_reason: Taking prostate or hair loss medications (finasteride, dutasteride) in the last 6 months contraindicates donation due to the teratogenic risk for female recipients.

items.label: Severe acne or eczema treatment
items.disqualification_reason: Isotretinoin (Roaccutan®...) is teratogenic. Taking it in the last 4 weeks contraindicates donation.

items.label: Psychiatric or neurological treatment
items.sublabel: Lithiofor®, Topamax®, Convulex®, Tegretol® (lithium, topiramate, anticonvulsants) : last 4 weeks
items.disqualification_reason: Taking psychiatric or neurological medications (lithium, topiramate, anticonvulsants) in the last 4 weeks contraindicates donation.

items.label: Endometriosis treatment
items.disqualification_reason: Taking endometriosis medication (Lucrin Depot®) in the last 2 months contraindicates donation.

items.label: HIV antiretroviral therapy (PrEP / PEP) or blood-derived medications
items.disqualification_reason: Taking antiretroviral therapy (PrEP/PEP) or blood-derived medications in the last 4 months contraindicates donation.

items.label: Cytostatic for psoriasis or arthritis
items.disqualification_reason: Taking Méthotrexate® in the last 6 months contraindicates donation.

items.label: Treatment for severe psoriasis or basal cell carcinoma
items.disqualification_reason: Taking Neotigason®, Acicutan® or Erivedge® in the last 3 years permanently contraindicates donation due to the very long-term teratogenic risk.

questions.content: Does any of these situations apply to you?
questions.hint: Certain vaccines and treatments require a waiting period before donation.

items.label: Any vaccine received in the last 4 weeks
items.disqualification_reason: A recent vaccine (in the last 4 weeks) requires a waiting period before donation. The exact delay varies depending on the vaccine.

items.label: Rabies or tetanus vaccine
items.disqualification_reason: A rabies or tetanus vaccine in the last 12 months temporarily contraindicates donation.

items.label: Immunotherapy using human or animal cells or serum
items.sublabel: at any point in your life
items.disqualification_reason: Immunotherapy based on human or animal products may contraindicate donation. Please inform the medical staff for assessment.

questions.content: Do you suffer or have you suffered from any of these diseases?
questions.hint: These medical histories may result in a temporary or permanent contraindication. If in doubt, consult the medical staff.

items.label: Cardiovascular disease
items.sublabel: severe arterial hypertension, myocardial infarction, heart failure, angina pectoris
items.disqualification_reason: A serious cardiovascular disease may contraindicate donation. Medical staff will assess your situation.

items.label: Severe lung disease
items.sublabel: uncontrolled asthma, COPD, respiratory failure, pulmonary embolism
items.disqualification_reason: Severe lung disease may contraindicate blood donation.

items.label: Stroke (CVA)
items.sublabel: transient ischaemic attack (TIA) or unexplained loss of consciousness
items.disqualification_reason: A stroke, TIA or unexplained loss of consciousness contraindicates blood donation.

items.label: Diabetes
items.disqualification_reason: Diabetes may contraindicate donation depending on the type and treatment. Medical staff will assess your situation.

items.label: Blood or coagulation disorder
items.sublabel: chronic anaemia, haemophilia, thrombocytopenia, thrombosis, sickle cell disease
items.disqualification_reason: A blood or coagulation disorder contraindicates blood donation.

items.label: Cancer or malignant tumour
items.sublabel: current or past, of any type
items.disqualification_reason: Some cancer histories may contraindicate donation. Medical staff will assess your situation based on the type and date of treatment.

items.label: Kidney disease
items.disqualification_reason: Kidney disease may contraindicate blood donation.

items.label: Neurological disease or epilepsy
items.disqualification_reason: Neurological disease or epilepsy may contraindicate blood donation.

items.label: Liver disease
items.disqualification_reason: Liver disease may contraindicate blood donation.

items.label: Severe osteoporosis
items.disqualification_reason: Severe osteoporosis may contraindicate blood donation.

items.label: Severe allergy or anaphylactic shock
items.disqualification_reason: A severe allergy or history of anaphylactic shock may contraindicate donation. Medical staff will assess your situation.

questions.content: In the last 3 years, have you been hospitalised, had surgery or been involved in an accident requiring medical care?
questions.hint: This includes: any surgery (outpatient or with hospitalisation), any hospitalisation of more than 24 hours, and any accident with medical care (fracture, significant injury, etc.). A simple emergency room visit without hospitalisation is not concerned.

options.label: Yes
options.disqualification_reason: A hospitalisation, operation or serious accident in the last 3 years requires a medical assessment before donation. Please specify the nature of the procedure to the medical staff.

questions.content: Have you received a blood transfusion or blood-derived product in the last 4 months?
questions.hint: Receiving blood or blood products from another donor requires a waiting period.

options.label: Yes
options.disqualification_reason: A blood transfusion in the last 4 months temporarily contraindicates donation, due to the risk of transmission of infectious agents.

questions.content: Does any of these situations apply to you?
questions.hint: These histories result in a definitive and permanent contraindication to blood donation.

items.label: Transplant of human or animal tissue
items.disqualification_reason: A transplant of human or animal tissue permanently contraindicates blood donation.

items.label: Organ transplant
items.disqualification_reason: An organ transplant permanently contraindicates blood donation.

items.label: Brain or spinal cord operation performed abroad
items.disqualification_reason: A brain or spinal cord operation performed abroad permanently contraindicates donation, due to the risk of transmitting Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.

items.label: Growth hormone or hormonal injections for infertility
items.disqualification_reason: Treatment with growth hormone before 1986 permanently contraindicates donation due to the risk of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (former pituitary-derived preparation).

items.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
items.sublabel: personal or family risk, even in case of doubt
items.disqualification_reason: A risk of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (for you or in your family) permanently contraindicates blood donation.

questions.content: In the last 6 months, have you travelled outside Switzerland?
questions.hint: Certain destinations present infectious risks (malaria, Zika, Ebola, Chagas...) requiring a waiting period after return.

data_schema.answer_format: { trips: [{ country: string, region: string, departure_date: string, return_date: string }] } | { no_travel: true }
data_schema.evaluation: For each trip, compare the region with risk_map. If the region is at risk AND the return date is less than waiting_period_months months ago, is_disqualifying = true.

Afrique subsaharienne.disqualification_reason: Travel to sub-Saharan Africa in the last 6 months temporarily contraindicates donation due to the risk of malaria and other endemic tropical diseases. Waiting period: 6 months after return.

Afrique du Nord.disqualification_reason: Travel to North Africa may require a waiting period depending on areas visited, due to the risks of leishmaniasis or bilharziasis.

Amérique centrale et du Sud.disqualification_reason: Travel to Central or South America in the last 6 months temporarily contraindicates donation due to the risks of malaria, Chagas disease and Zika virus.

Asie du Sud et du Sud-Est.disqualification_reason: Travel to South or Southeast Asia in the last 6 months temporarily contraindicates donation due to the risks of malaria and other tropical diseases.

Moyen-Orient (zones à risque).disqualification_reason: Travel to certain areas of the Middle East in the last 6 months may temporarily contraindicate donation depending on the regions visited.

options.label: No, I have not travelled outside Switzerland in the last 6 months

questions.content: Does any of these situations apply to you?
questions.hint: Certain geographic origins may require additional tests related to endemic diseases.

data_schema.answer_format: { items: string[], countries: string[] } | { none: true }
data_schema.evaluation: If an item is selected, mark needs_evaluation = true. Compare the stated countries with risk_map to identify potential diseases to test.

Afrique subsaharienne.disqualification_reason: Additional tests (sickle cell screening, hepatitis B) may be required depending on the country of origin. Medical staff will assess your situation.

Amérique centrale et du Sud.disqualification_reason: A Chagas disease screening test may be required depending on the country of origin or childhood residence.

Asie du Sud-Est.disqualification_reason: Additional tests may be required depending on the country of origin. Medical staff will assess your situation.

items.label: Born outside Switzerland or having grown up there
items.sublabel: more than 6 months — specify the country

items.label: Mother born in a non-European country
items.sublabel: grew up or lived there more than 6 months — specify the country

options.label: No, neither I nor my mother correspond to these situations

questions.content: Have you ever suffered from any of these infectious diseases?
questions.hint: These diseases may require a waiting period or medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Toxoplasmosis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of toxoplasmosis may require a waiting period before donation. Please specify the date to the medical staff.

items.label: Infectious mononucleosis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of mononucleosis may require a waiting period before donation depending on the date of illness.

items.label: Amoebiasis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of amoebiasis may require a waiting period before donation.

items.label: Shigellosis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of shigellosis may require a waiting period before donation.

items.label: TBE
items.disqualification_reason: A history of TBE may require a waiting period before donation.

items.label: Bilharziasis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of bilharziasis requires a medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Gonorrhoea
items.disqualification_reason: A history of gonorrhoea may require a waiting period before donation.

items.label: Osteomyelitis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of osteomyelitis requires a medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Rheumatic fever
items.disqualification_reason: A history of rheumatic fever may require a waiting period before donation.

items.label: Tuberculosis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of tuberculosis requires a thorough medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Relapsing fever
items.disqualification_reason: A history of relapsing fever requires a medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Q fever
items.disqualification_reason: A history of Q fever requires a medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Guillain-Barré syndrome
items.disqualification_reason: A history of Guillain-Barré syndrome may contraindicate donation.

questions.content: Have you ever contracted any of these serious infectious diseases?
questions.hint: These diseases result in an extended or permanent contraindication due to the risk of transmission to the recipient.

items.label: Malaria
items.disqualification_reason: A history of malaria contraindicates donation for 3 years after fully documented recovery.

items.label: Chagas disease
items.disqualification_reason: A history of Chagas disease permanently contraindicates donation due to the risk of transmission to the recipient via blood.

items.label: Brucellosis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of brucellosis requires a medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Echinococcosis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of echinococcosis requires a medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Leishmaniasis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of leishmaniasis may contraindicate donation due to the risk of transmission via blood.

items.label: Lymphogranuloma venereum (LGV)
items.disqualification_reason: A history of LGV requires a medical assessment before donation.

items.label: Filariasis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of filariasis may contraindicate donation.

items.label: Babesiosis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of babesiosis contraindicates donation for an extended period.

items.label: Ebola virus disease
items.sublabel: or stay in an active epidemic zone
items.disqualification_reason: A history of Ebola or a stay in an active epidemic zone permanently contraindicates donation.

items.label: Other serious infection not listed
items.disqualification_reason: A past serious infection may contraindicate donation. Please specify the disease to the medical staff for assessment.

questions.content: In the last 4 weeks, does any of these situations apply to you?
questions.hint: These recent exposures may temporarily contraindicate donation.

items.label: Tick bite
items.disqualification_reason: A tick bite in the last 4 weeks requires a waiting period before donation, due to the risk of Lyme disease or tick-borne encephalitis.

items.label: Close contact with a person with a contagious infectious disease
items.sublabel: specify the disease to medical staff
items.disqualification_reason: Recent contact with a contagious person may require a waiting period depending on the disease in question.

questions.content: In the last 4 months, have you undergone any of these procedures?
questions.hint: These procedures carry a risk of transmission of infectious agents through blood or instruments.

items.label: Tattoo
items.disqualification_reason: A tattoo in the last 4 months temporarily contraindicates donation, due to the risk of transmitting hepatitis or other infections.

items.label: Piercing
items.disqualification_reason: A piercing in the last 4 months temporarily contraindicates donation.

items.label: Permanent makeup or Microblading
items.disqualification_reason: Permanent makeup or microblading in the last 4 months temporarily contraindicates donation.

items.label: Acupuncture treatment
items.disqualification_reason: Acupuncture treatment in the last 4 months may temporarily contraindicate donation if the needles were not certified single-use.

items.label: Electrolysis hair removal
items.disqualification_reason: Electrolysis hair removal in the last 4 months may temporarily contraindicate donation.

items.label: Gastroscopy or colonoscopy
items.disqualification_reason: A gastroscopy or colonoscopy in the last 4 months temporarily contraindicates donation due to the risk of transmitting infections.

items.label: Use of medical leeches
items.disqualification_reason: The use of medical leeches in the last 4 months temporarily contraindicates donation.

items.label: Contact with foreign blood
items.sublabel: needle prick, splash in eyes, mouth or open wound
items.disqualification_reason: Contact with foreign blood in the last 4 months temporarily contraindicates donation due to the risk of transmitting HIV, hepatitis B/C or other infections.

questions.content: Have you ever tested positive for any of these diseases?
questions.hint: These diseases result in a definitive and permanent contraindication to blood donation.

items.label: HIV / AIDS
items.disqualification_reason: HIV infection permanently contraindicates blood donation.

items.label: Hepatitis B
items.disqualification_reason: Hepatitis B (even past) permanently contraindicates blood donation.

items.label: Hepatitis C
items.disqualification_reason: Hepatitis C (even cured) permanently contraindicates blood donation.

items.label: Syphilis
items.disqualification_reason: A history of syphilis temporarily contraindicates donation. Please inform the medical staff for assessment.

questions.content: Does any of these situations apply to you?
questions.hint: These situations temporarily increase the risk of transmitting infections during the seroconversion window.

items.label: New partner or more than 2 partners
items.disqualification_reason: A new partner, change of partner or more than 2 partners in the last 4 months requires a waiting period due to the risk of STIs during the seroconversion window.

items.label: Sexual relations for payment
items.sublabel: money, drugs or other services — last 12 months
items.disqualification_reason: Sexual relations for payment in the last 12 months temporarily contraindicate donation due to an increased risk of STI exposure.

items.label: Partner with hepatitis B/C, Zika or exposed to HIV
items.disqualification_reason: A partner with hepatitis B/C, Zika or exposed to a risk situation in the last 12 months temporarily contraindicates donation.

items.label: Partner who stayed in a country with high HIV / hepatitis prevalence
items.disqualification_reason: Sexual relations with a partner returning from a high-prevalence country in the last 4 months require a waiting period.

options.label: None of these situations apply to me

questions.content: Does any of these situations apply to you?
questions.hint: The use of injectable or synthetic drugs significantly increases the risk of transmitting blood-borne infections.

items.label: Drug injection
items.disqualification_reason: Past or present use of injectable drugs permanently contraindicates blood donation, due to the high risk of transmitting HIV and hepatitis B and C via the bloodstream.

items.label: Sexual relations under the influence of synthetic drugs
items.disqualification_reason: Sexual relations under synthetic drugs in the last 12 months temporarily contraindicate donation due to an increased risk of STI exposure.

options.label: No, none of these situations apply to me

questions.content: Are you currently pregnant or have you been in the last 6 months?
questions.hint: Pregnancy and breastfeeding temporarily contraindicate donation for the mother's safety.

options.label: Yes
options.disqualification_reason: Pregnancy or a recent birth (within the last 6 months) temporarily contraindicates blood donation. You may donate again 6 months after delivery and after stopping breastfeeding.
